text:
Maria: Quick provision handshake for Pioneer Telemetry (acct: pioneer-telemetry). Emailed signed contract this morning. They want a Dedicated pod (4x A100 equiv) in eu-west + burst to demo. Also require KMS for customer-managed keys and EU data residency. Onboarding blocked: need DPA signed + SSO metadata and KMS scope. POC reveals unusually high token churn from repeated assistant system messages — we should handle before they scale or costs will blow out. Renewal ~330 days; medium risk if DPA/KMS timeline slips.

Sam: Thanks for the context. Can you drop the contract link + DPA owner? I'll shepherd CS side and track renewal risk. Owners I'm assigning: Ana (SSO + DPA ingestion), Rory (model & prompt remediation), Liam (infra/KMS & provisioning), Tanya (kickoff + enablement). I'll create CS ticket and a renewal-watch.

Maria: Contract + DPA uploaded: <https://redwood.internal/storage/pioneer_contract_v2.pdf|pioneer_contract_v2>. DPA owner: legal@pioneer.example.com (cc Carla). KMS admin: ops@pioneer.example.com. They explicitly asked for a demo tenant isolated from production traffic.

Ana: I'll take SSO. Need IdP metadata (XML or metadata URL), ACS URL, and SAML cert. Also confirm whether they want IdP-initiated or SP-initiated. Maria?

Maria: IdP is Okta. Carla confirmed SP-initiated. She'll send metadata today. Also note: their current cert uses RSA 1024, flagged by security. They'll reissue with recommended 2048.

Rory: I'll analyze prompt patterns and propose a compact system message and a KV cache prefix strategy. Plan: reduce system message verbosity, canonicalize prompts, and add a token budget guardrail. Will produce a short remediation doc + eval set by EOD tomorrow. Also include a canary rollout plan to staging so we can validate quality vs token savings.

Liam: For KMS and provisioning I need the customer KMS ARN + whether they want HSM-backed keys. Also need network constraints for private deployment in eu-west. I can provision the dedicated pod once DPA and KMS are confirmed.

Tanya: I'll set up the kickoff and the demo tenant timeline. Suggesting Tue 11am CET. Invite will include CS, SE, Support, Infra, and Legal. Will also prep onboarding playbook and enablement lab credentials for the customer demo team.

Sam: Action summary I logged:
- Ana: collect IdP metadata, confirm SP-init, upload to SSO queue (owner: Ana)
- Rory: remediation doc + eval set + canary plan (owner: Rory)
- Liam: KMS provisioning checklist + network constraints (owner: Liam)
- Tanya: schedule kickoff + demo tenant prep (owner: Tanya)
- Maria: confirm DPA signature ETA + share KMS admin contact (owner: Maria)
- Sam: create CS ticket, add renewal-watch, add cost-cap alert for demo (owner: Sam)

Maria: Shared metadata coming from Carla now. Also asked product team for a temporary cost cap on demo traffic — they want a hard cap alert before burst.

Ana: Got metadata. Two quick issues: (1) SAML cert is expiring in 18 days; they need a replacement ASAP; (2) Assertion includes an extra attribute we don't use (employeeType)  we can ignore but want to confirm. Looping Carla.

Rory: Draft remediation doc: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pioneer-remediation-v1|runbook-remediation>. Highlights: compact system prompt templates, merge repeated context into KV cache, enable token-budget middleware, and recommended quantization profile for their model. Estimated token savings: 25-35% in POC. Canary plan in doc.

handoff-bot: CS ticket #CS-4987 created and assigned to Sam.

Sam: Good progress. We'll run canary in staging after SSO cert is rotated and KMS confirmed. Please post final remediation doc into CS-4987 and tag me. Next sync Thursday 10am CET to confirm DPA returned, cert rotated, and runbook feedback.

Liam: Noted. I'll start infra prep but will hold final provisioning until DPA + customer KMS ARN present. If they want HSM keys we'll need 3 extra days.

Tanya: Kickoff invite sent for Tue 11am CET. Added agenda: provisioning timeline, SSO checklist, KMS + network, runbook overview, demo tenant and cost caps.

Maria: I'll chase Legal for DPA signature and confirm KMS ARN. Will also ask the customer to approve demo cost cap.

Checklist:
```
Pre-provision checklist:
- DPA signed
- IdP metadata & new cert
- Customer KMS ARN + HSM preference
- Demo tenant isolation plan
- Runbook remediation v1 + evals
- Cost cap/alert configured
```

Sam: Thanks team  capture any customer feedback in the shared drive and reference CS-4987. If anyone hits blockers, drop them in this thread or @sam. :thumbsup:
